gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
This job calls ___ someone with patience.
gaps.explanation: call for = require, demand (circumstances call for action).

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).
